purpose: Add a formula-neutral raw strong-lensing adapter that projects a separately typed 3D photon field, profiles one source position per observed image family, globally finds image-plane roots, assigns predicted roots to observed images, and treats missing multiplicity as a topology failure rather than a finite subset RMS.

axisConvention.constraint: the three axes are a permutation of [0,1,2]

numericalContract.sourceProfiling: beta_family is the mean ray-shot source position of the observed images
numericalContract.rootSearch: global sign-change and residual-minimum seeding followed by bounded nonlinear closure
numericalContract.assignment: minimum-cost one-to-one assignment in the east/north image plane
numericalContract.completeScore: uncertainty-aware two-coordinate image residual likelihood after subtracting two profiled source-position degrees of freedom per family
numericalContract.incompleteScore: aggregate image-position RMSE, chi-square, and likelihood are null when any family has fewer assigned roots than observed images
numericalContract.criticalCurves: optional per-family determinant sign-change points are diagnostic unless an independent parity or arc-orientation observable is supplied

artifactContract: observation_multiple_image_predictions.csv retains every observed image including unmatched images
observation_multiple_image_families.csv retains source, root-count, multiplicity, RMS, chi-square, and nuisance accounting per family
observation_multiple_image_roots.npz retains predicted roots, closure errors, magnifications, and optional critical-curve points
all artifacts are content-hashed and byte-stable between integrated and decoupled observation jobs

acceptanceFixtures.purpose: recover a profiled source, two global roots, exact multiplicity, and sub-milliarcsecond image RMS
prove that one predicted root for two observed images yields null aggregate RMS and an explicit incomplete_topology state
prove that family distance ratios change photon roots without changing the source field identity
preserve named east/north roots and assignments after permuting storage axes and vector components
integrated and standalone evaluation jobs emit byte-identical score, family, prediction, and root artifacts
serialize existing secure AS295 and PLCKG287 image families without coordinate swaps, family loss, or invented uncertainties

claimBoundary: P0735 evaluates raw image-plane positions against a submitted photon field; it does not validate the equation that generated the field.
Profiling a source position is an explicitly counted observational nuisance operation, not a gravity parameter fit.
A complete synthetic root recovery validates numerical conformance only; it is not evidence that a baryon-only model explains a real cluster.
Published image coordinates, family membership, redshift-to-distance ratios, uncertainties, and selection rules require independent provenance.
Critical curves are diagnostic unless independent parity or arc-orientation data make them observables.
Time delays, flux ratios, microlensing, line-of-sight structure, and cosmological inference remain outside P0735.
